get.summary: Get a resource's stored representation (the pipe)
get.description:
Returns the stored representation's bytes, verbatim, with the stored media type in Content-Type (`application/octet-stream` when the stored metadata carries none). The Accept header is never read: there is no content negotiation and no transcoding, so the served bytes always hash to the representation's registered checksum.

The resource's JSON-LD description (descriptor + annotations + inbound entity references) lives at GET /resources/{id}/jsonld; every content response advertises it via a `Link: rel="describedby"` header.

Content is immutable (checksum-addressed), and this route is bearer-authenticated, so responses carry `Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`.

200.description: The stored representation's bytes, verbatim, with the stored media type as Content-Type (`application/octet-stream` when none is recorded).

Link.description: `</resources/{id}/jsonld>; rel="describedby"; type="application/ld+json"` — where the resource's JSON-LD description is.

Cache-Control.description: Content is immutable; `private` because this route is bearer-authenticated and a shared cache must not serve it to anyone else.

404.description: `Resource not found` when the knowledge base has no such resource, or the path's `{id}` is not a `ResourceId` and so names none; `Resource representation not found` when it has the resource but not its bytes.
